author: kokonutd
name: ai-input-with-search
description:
A modern chat input component with a web search toggle and file upload functionality. This component features an animated search toggle, file attachment support, and smooth transitions.

Features:
	•	Animated search toggle button
	•	File upload support
	•	Auto-resizing textarea
	•	Dark mode compatibility
	•	Keyboard shortcuts
	•	Framer Motion animations for enhanced user experience
	•	Mobile responsiveness
